metadata.title: Geometry of a class of $φ$-minimal surfaces in $\mathbb{H}^2\times \mathbb{R}$
metadata.abstract: We study a class of $\varphi$-minimal surfaces in the product space $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{R}$, that is, weighted minimal surfaces whose corresponding weight is determined by a smooth potential function $\varphi$ that depends only on the height coordinate relative to the factor $\mathbb{R}$. Under monotonicity, concavity, and asymptotic conditions on $\varphi$, we obtain a complete classification of connected, properly embedded $\varphi$-minimal surfaces that are invariant under isometries of $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{R}$ acting trivially on $\mathbb{R}$ and by rotations or parabolic translations on $\mathbb{H}^2$. Finally, we establish several non-existence results for $\varphi$-minimal surfaces in $\mathbb{H}^2 \times \mathbb{R}$, either by using properties of the height function or by applying the tangency principle together with suitable invariant surfaces as barriers.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对 H²×R 中仅依赖高度的权函数，在单调、凹性及渐近条件下分类旋转或抛物平移不变的连通正常嵌入 φ-极小曲面，并用高度函数和屏障建立不存在结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 为一类加权曲面提供完整对称模型和可用屏障。
analysis.limitations: 分类仅覆盖指定对称性与权函数条件，不能当作所有 φ-极小曲面的分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 对乘积空间中的几何变分和屏障构造实用。
